descriptor: Social reach analytics for small teams

voice.summary: Chirpwise explains numbers the way a friendly strategist would over coffee. It leads with what rose or fell, names the post, and never buries a bad week under vanity metrics.
dos: Say what changed and by how much
Name the network and the post
Compare with the previous period in plain words
donts: Do not call a small dip a 'crisis'
Do not use 'engagement' without saying what was counted

taglines: See who you reached and why
Know which post earned its keep
boilerplate: Chirpwise is an analytics tool that tracks reach across Loop, Frame and Chirp and shows small teams which posts are actually growing their audience.

microcopy.success: Report exported. Your CSV is ready.

logo.note: A speech bubble represents posts and the conversation behind reach.
